newsitem.title: USA: Armco ups prices for stainless products.
newsitem.headline: Armco ups prices for stainless products.

text.p: Armco Inc said Thursday it will increase prices for stainless steel cold-rolled sheet and strip and stainless hot-rolled products, effective with March 3, 1997 shipments.
The company said transaction prices will increase about five percent via a three percent reduction in service center and end-user discounts.
The company said the current surcharge mechanism, applicable to nickel, chrome and molybdenum, will remain in place.

Armco is a domestic producer of specialty flat-rolled stainless, electrical and galvanized steels with plants in Butler, Pennsylvania and Coshocton, Dover, Mansfield and Zanesville, Ohio. Armco also owns companies which produce snowplows and other snow and ice control products, and standard pipe and tubular products.
